events.text: The heading check is too loose: it treats any quoted command after a path as a heading. I'm looking at how the guides actually cite headings so I can tighten it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: See phrasing between path and quoted text
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/revops-os/dist/tantra-revops-os; grep -rhoE '(knowledge|kits)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.md[^"`'"'"'\n]{0,40}["`'"'"'][^"`'"'"']{3,60}' tasks CLAUDE.md README.md | sed -E 's/^[^ ,(]*\.md//' | sed -E 's/["`'"'"'].*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find real heading citation forms
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/revops-os/dist/tantra-revops-os; grep -rhoE '(knowledge|kits)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.md.{0,60}' tasks CLAUDE.md | grep -iE 'under|section|heading|, "|#' | head -15; grep -rhoE '(knowledge|kits)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.md#[A-Za-z0-9-]+' tasks CLAUDE.md | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show heading-style citations
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/revops-os/dist/tantra-revops-os; grep -rnE '(knowledge|kits)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.md(: Part 1|,? (under )?["`])' tasks CLAUDE.md README.md knowledge scripts/api.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head

events.text: Guides cite headings as `path, under "Heading"`. I'm narrowing the check to that form plus `#anchor`, and adding knowledge/ files to the scan so cross-links are checked too.
